text:
Hi, question about insurance for b1 holder.
We applied for Macabbi welcome insurance months ago, first we had issues with doing a blood tests and every time we did them they were requesting for more and more of them which is not a problem but without insurance it’s a really big amount of money to spend. Then after we completed the all tests they told us everything is okey and pushed our application further. Now after weeks of not hearing from them they asking us to do a weight and height check with a doctor sign, even tho all the tests were good. I don’t want to pay 500NIS in private clinic for just a weight and height check it’s crazy for me. Is this normal? If yes so is there a way to do it cheaper, anyone know a place to do it? I need insurance badly but feel like they are doing everything to not give it to me. (We started with macabi because it’s the only one in our city that have option for b1 holders and it’s more simple to have it next to us when I’m sick than traveling to another city but if it’s common that they doing it I’ll consider another places)
